name: ed-mcp
description: Elite Dangerous tools for Claude: Inara, EDSM, Frontier CAPI, Spansh, game data, SLEF builds and engineering plans.

tools.name: inara_commander_profile
tools.description: Ranks, squadron, main ship and Inara URL

tools.name: edsm_commander_location
tools.description: Last known system and docked station

tools.name: capi_login
tools.description: Log in to Frontier in the browser

tools.name: capi_profile
tools.description: Current ship with engineering, location and fleet

tools.name: build_parse_slef
tools.description: Parse a SLEF build from EDSY, Coriolis or Inara

tools.name: catalog_blueprint
tools.description: Blueprint materials per grade and experimentals

tools.name: catalog_engineers
tools.description: Engineers for a blueprint, or one engineer's offers

tools.name: catalog_material
tools.description: Material grade, trade group and trade rules

tools.name: catalog_module
tools.description: Outfitting module by symbol or name

tools.name: materials_plan
tools.description: Plan material needs, trades and traders for engineering

tools.name: spansh_find_stations
tools.description: Best stations near a system, ranked by travel time and cost

tools.name: journal_commander
tools.description: Commander, location, ship and cargo from the journal

tools.name: journal_materials
tools.description: Engineering materials held, from the journal

tools.name: cache_refresh
tools.description: Clear cached data or refresh game data

inara_api_key.title: Inara API key
inara_api_key.description: Personal API key from inara.cz > Settings > Inara API. Leave empty to disable Inara tools.

inara_dev_mode.title: Inara development mode
inara_dev_mode.description: Keep on until Inara has whitelisted the app name ed-mcp.

edsm_api_key.title: EDSM API key
edsm_api_key.description: API key from edsm.net > Settings > API Key. Leave empty to disable EDSM tools.

capi_client_id.title: Frontier CAPI client ID
capi_client_id.description: Client ID from user.frontierstore.net/developer. Leave empty to disable Frontier login.

ed_journal_dir.title: Journal folder
ed_journal_dir.description: The Elite Dangerous journal folder. On the gaming PC leave empty for the default; on a Mac choose the Syncthing copy.
